facts: The Boy Scouts and Girl Scouts both offer merit badges in dog care.
Fifteen people die in the U.S. every year from dog bites.
A dog's nose is so sensitive that they can detect minute changes in the earth's magnetic field.
Tired puppies get cranky just like little kids. If you have a fussy puppy, try nap time.
The most popular breed of dog in the US is the Labrador Retriever.
